title: A schematic with variants, part attributes and a module instance
how: Counted from the file: 3 layer lines; 2 part lines; 1 net line with 1 segment; 1 sheet; 1 embedded library;
the element modules is not one the reader interprets, so it is counted once (uninterpreted.modules) and noted with PHOENIX-EAGLE-009;
the variantdefs, attributes, classes and description are known elements and add nothing.
